title: FakeAgent reported backup C2 domain
description: A tool command URL or uniquely correlated network observation uses the backup SectopRAT domain reported in the FakeAgent investigation.
falsepositives: Approved threat-intelligence validation may query the domain.
investigation: Review DNS and proxy logs, response content, process lineage, and any repeated beaconing. Compare with approved task scope.

classification.rationale: A reported C2 indicator alone does not identify an AI-specific technique.
